title: nan
authors: Zhang H.; Miao C.; Zhang L.; Zhang Y.; Li Y.; Fang K.
key_contribution: Presents a real-time simulator plus a novel inertial-aided scene-matching navigation algorithm and relative navigation method for UAV swarms in GNSS-denied environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
